# TASK 1: Architecture & GPIO pinout mapping

Source of truth: `hardware/lib/board_spec.py`, `esp32p4_pinout.py`, `impedance.py`. `validate()`: **clean**.

## 1. Architecture

ESP32-P4NRW32X (Dual-core RISC-V 400 MHz SoC, 32 MB in-package PSRAM, chip rev v3.x; QFN-104 10x10 mm, 0.35 mm pitch, EPAD 7.5 mm) sits at the design origin under a 25 x 25 mm heatsink keep-out. 231 component instances (219 fitted, non-mechanical), 175 nets, 67 part types, 4-layer 1.6 mm HDI board, 110 x 80 mm.

## 4. Strapping and boot

| GPIO | Net | Reset state | Netlist (pulls / switches) | Level at reset | Spec note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GPIO34 | `RMII_TXD0` | IE (at reset) | U5.TXD0 via R41 | undefined: no board pull (only U5.TXD0 via R41 on the net) | Strap: JTAG source select, only if EFUSE_JTAG_SEL_ENABLE is burned (default: ignored); PHY input, never driven at reset |
| GPIO35 | `RMII_TXD1` | IE, WPU (at reset) | R7 10k to +3V3, Q1.C2 via R9 1k, SW2 to GND via R9 1k, U5.TXD1 via R42 | 1 (external pull-up R7) | Boot strap: 10k pull-up, BOOT button + auto-program NPN to GND |
| GPIO36 | `STRAP_GPIO36` | IE (at reset) | R8 10k to +3V3 | 1 (external pull-up R8) | 10k pull-up, otherwise unused (must read 1 for joint-download boot) |
| GPIO37 | `UART0_TXD` | IE (at reset) | U6.RXD | undefined: no board pull (only U6.RXD on the net) | Strapping pin (boot-mode 'any value') |
| GPIO38 | `UART0_RXD` | IE (at reset) | U6.TXD | undefined: no board pull (only U6.TXD on the net) | Strapping pin (boot-mode 'any value') |

| GPIO35 | GPIO36 | Boot mode | How the board gets there |
| :---: | :---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | x | SPI boot (normal) | R7 pull-up holds GPIO35 high |
| 0 | 1 | Joint download boot (UART0 / USB) | Q1 or SW2 pulls GPIO35 low while CHIP_PU rises; R8 keeps GPIO36 = 1 |
| 0 | 0 | not a listed boot mode | prevented: nothing in the netlist pulls GPIO36 low |

Review flag (computed): GPIO35 is also `RMII_TXD1` (50 MHz RMII TX). Straight-line distance from U1 pad 66 to each active device on that net: . The BOOT button and auto-program transistor therefore add a long stub on the SoC side of the series resistor; keep the stub short or isolate it with a series resistor (~1k) at the tap -- with the R7 10k pull-up a 1k series still gives a valid low (~0.3 V).

Strapping pins with no defined level at reset: GPIO34, GPIO37, GPIO38. Acceptable only where the spec note says the strap value is ignored ('any value' / eFuse-gated); otherwise add a pull.

| VDD_LP/VDD_BAT | VDD_LP (pad 9) = `+3V3`, 3.30 V via U3 TPS62130 buck + L1 2.2uH<br>VDD_BAT (pad 102) = `VDD_BAT`, 3.30 V via R2 0R | 0-3 | 0-3 | - |
| VDD_LP | VDD_LP (pad 9) = `+3V3`, 3.30 V via U3 TPS62130 buck + L1 2.2uH | 4-15 | 4-15 | - |
| VDD_IO_0 | VDD_IO_0 (pad 21) = `+3V3`, 3.30 V via U3 TPS62130 buck + L1 2.2uH | 16-23 | 16-23 | - |

| VDD_IO_5 | VDD_IO_5 (pad 85) = `VDDO_4_SDIO`, SoC LDO via U1 on-chip LDO VDDO_4 (pad 74) | 39-48 | 39-44 | 45-48 |
| VDD_IO_6 | VDD_IO_6 (pad 96) = `+3V3`, 3.30 V via U3 TPS62130 buck + L1 2.2uH | 49-54 | 49-54 | - |

* GPIO45-48 are NC: domain VDD_IO_5 is `VDDO_4_SDIO`, the on-chip LDO output that is 0 V at boot and 1.8 V in UHS-I mode (VDD_IO_5/VDDO_4 domain (0 V at boot, 1.8 V in UHS-I); reserved).
* The SDIO pads GPIO39-44 share that domain, so the card bus is dead until firmware enables the LDO; the card pull-ups R65-R69 go to the same `VDDO_4_SDIO` rail.
* The card power switch GPIO20 `SD_PWR_EN` is in VDD_IO_0 = `+3V3`: a 3.3 V high fully turns off the P-FET (3.3 V domain so it can fully turn off the P-FET); netlist: Q2.G, R70 10k to GND.
